question_text: Define the term histology. What is it otherwise called?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What histology is
steps.why: The definition names the level of study — tissues seen under a microscope — which is what separates histology from anatomy, the study of parts seen with the unaided eye.
common_mistakes: Writing that histology is the study of cells. That is cytology; histology is the study of tissues.
Writing that histology is the study of organs seen with the unaided eye. That is gross anatomy.
steps.memory_tip: Histo means tissue: histology is tissue study under a microscope.
steps.margin_note: One sentence. Name tissues and the microscope.

steps.label: The other name
steps.why: The second name is the first one explained: micro plus anatomy says exactly what histology does.
common_mistakes: Writing 'micrology' or 'microbiology'. The other name is microanatomy.
steps.memory_tip: Micro plus anatomy: the same subject at a smaller scale.
steps.margin_note: One word carries this mark. Write microanatomy and one line to justify it.

insider_note: The second half is a single word — microanatomy — and it is the half most students leave out, so write it even when you are short of time.
